summary.text: Eddy Dempsey was elected in 2020 to represent House District 1 in the Oklahoma House of Representatives. He was born in Idabel and previously worked as a field representative for Congressman Markwayne Mullin.

paragraphs.text: Dempsey graduated from Valliant High School and Southeastern Oklahoma State University, and served on the Valliant School Board for five years.
He and his wife have two sons, and his family owns a small farm in Valliant.
